pages.title: Hypervelocity Impact Forge
pages.text: A railgun: an armature shot down two rails at kilometres a second into a target, where the shock makes what only impacts can.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the current and the armature's mass. The rails push with F = ½L′I²; the armature leaves at v = √(2FL/m) and hits with a pressure of about ½ρv². Each product forms only in its own pressure window. Each shot uses a Rail Armature.

pages.name: Hypervelocity Impact Forge
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Exoplanet Core Sample, Lonsdaleite, Moissanite.
